name: rough-cut-mvp
description: A free screen recorder and editor for Linux (X11): record, trim, zoom, add animated graphics and export MP4.
author: Noam Naumovsky

scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test scripts/export-benchmark-utils.test.mjs scripts/export-test-lock.test.mjs scripts/release-metadata.test.mjs && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --sort test
scripts.smoke:real-recording: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/smoke-real-recording.mjs
scripts.smoke:long-recording: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/smoke-long-recording.mjs
scripts.smoke:recording-flow-ui: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/smoke-recording-flow-ui.mjs
scripts.smoke:recording-startup-ui: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/smoke-recording-startup-ui.mjs
scripts.smoke:ui: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/smoke-ui.mjs && node scripts/smoke-sidebar-layout.mjs
scripts.verify:recording-edit-regressions: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1920x1080x24' node scripts/recording-edit-regressions-playwright.mjs
scripts.smoke:sidebar-layout: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/smoke-sidebar-layout.mjs
scripts.smoke:styled-export: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/smoke-styled-export.mjs
scripts.benchmark:export: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/benchmark-export.mjs
scripts.visual:export: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/visual-export-playwright.mjs
scripts.visual:export-layout: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/visual-export-layout-parity.mjs
scripts.visual:nle-export-parity: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/visual-nle-export-parity.mjs
scripts.visual:scrub: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/visual-scrub-playwright.mjs
scripts.probe:webgpu: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/probe-webgpu-capability.mjs
scripts.playback:timeline: pnpm --filter @rough-cut/project-model build && pnpm --filter @rough-cut/desktop build && node scripts/playback-timeline-playwright.mjs
scripts.package:linux: pnpm electron:install && pnpm tools:prepare && pnpm build && node scripts/package-linux.mjs
scripts.smoke:package-recording-flow: pnpm package:linux && node scripts/smoke-packaged-recording-flow.mjs && pnpm verify:recording-linked-lanes
scripts.test:release: ROUGH_CUT_RELEASE_ARTIFACT=1 pnpm package:linux && node --test scripts/package-linux-portable.test.mjs scripts/ui-visual-proof.test.mjs && pnpm test
